title: Dijkstra’s Algorithm
problem: Reference entry: Dijkstra’s Algorithm, a canonical graphs algorithm.
description: Expands the closest unvisited node first, settling shortest paths from the start. Requires non-negative weights.
pseudocode: if d + w < dist[v]: dist[v] = d + w; push(pq, (dist[v], v))
